$comment: Hand fixes applied on top of the OSM import (PLAN.md §4.1). Survives re-imports: refer to OSM ids and coordinates, never to generated segment ids. osm.includeWays/excludeWays: OSM way ids to force in/out of the in-service network (applied by import-osm). turns.add/remove: {node: [lon, lat], a: [lon, lat], b: [lon, lat], note} — at the node nearest `node` (≤5 m), allow/forbid passing between the incident tracks nearest `a` and `b`. platforms: {stop: GTFS stop_name, near: [lon, lat], note} pins that stop to the track nearest `near`. addTrack: GeoJSON of track missing from OSM (joined to existing track within 4 m of its endpoints).

osm.$excludeWaysNote: Braid–Lougheed Expo track closed until ~2027 for the OMC4 flyover works (confirmed by Braden, 2026-09-26); the other track is single-tracked. OPEN-QUESTIONS #17.

platforms.note: GTFS coordinate lies on the scissors crossover ~100 m south of the platform; pinned to the northbound stub (OSM way 923508922) 35 m from the buffer stop.
As P5: pinned to the other stub (OSM way 923508923) 35 m from the buffer stop.
